brands.brand_voice_summary: Samsung speaks like a confident engineer-poet: it frames hardware and AI as tools that expand human capability, favoring sleek, benefit-first language over dry spec lists.
style_rules: Lead with the human outcome, not the feature name (e.g. 'See more, miss less' before 'Galaxy AI').
Use short, declarative sentence fragments for punch; reserve longer sentences for ecosystem/connectivity claims.
Preferred vocabulary: 'unfold', 'seamless', 'intelligent', 'ecosystem', 'do more'; avoid overtly technical jargon like 'nanometer' or 'API' in consumer copy.
Capitalize product and feature names consistently (Galaxy AI, SmartThings, Multi Control) and treat them as proper nouns mid-sentence.
reference_ad_copies: Unfold what's next.
Epic is back.
Do bigger things.
Galaxy AI is here.
The future unfolds.
Your world, connected. From your phone to your fridge, SmartThings keeps every screen and sensor working together, so your home responds before you ask.
Circle to Search turns curiosity into an answer in one motion — no app switching, no typing, just circle and go.
A display that thinks ahead: adaptive brightness, richer color, and a refresh rate that matches your every scroll and swipe.
Note-taking, reimagined. Write it, say it, or type it — Galaxy AI organizes your thoughts into something you can actually use.
Life moves fast. Your camera should too — zero shutter lag, real-time object tracking, and low-light clarity that doesn't quit.
Two screens. One seamless story. Multitask like the future already arrived, because it did.
Battery that keeps pace with your ambition, not the other way around.
Translate live, across 13 languages, mid-conversation — like having a fluent friend in your pocket.
Built for the next decade, not just the next update: durable, repairable, and ready for what's coming.
This is your sign to upgrade the way you create, connect, and get things done — welcome to the Galaxy ecosystem.

brands.brand_voice_summary: Duolingo talks like a chaotic, lovable friend who genuinely wants you to practice — equal parts encouragement, guilt-trip, and internet-native humor, wrapped around streaks and XP.
style_rules: Use first-person, conversational phrasing as if the owl itself is texting the user ('I noticed you skipped Spanish today...').
Lean into exaggerated urgency and mock threats about streaks for comedic effect — never genuinely mean-spirited.
Favor lowercase casing, ellipses, and emoji-adjacent punctuation in social captions; keep app-level notifications short and imperative ('Time to practice!').
Gamification vocabulary is constant: 'streak', 'XP', 'leaderboard', 'gems', 'level up' — treat these as core brand nouns, not occasional flourishes.
reference_ad_copies: Learn a language for free. Forever.

Your Spanish teacher from high school would be so disappointed right now. Just saying.

POV: it's 11:58pm and you remember your streak exists. we've all been there, no judgment (some judgment)
Turns out 'I'll do it tomorrow' has been said 47 times this month. Duo is watching. Duo is patient. Duo is not that patient.
Leaderboards are back and so is your competitive streak — climb to Diamond before your rival does.
New year, same Duo, same nagging, same results. Let's get fluent.
Bite-sized lessons that fit into literally any part of your day, including the bathroom, no judgment.
We built an entire chess course because apparently language wasn't enough chaos for one app.
Congrats on your 100-day streak! Duo is shedding a single, proud, slightly unsettling tear.

brands.brand_voice_summary: Nike speaks in short, commanding bursts that turn effort into identity — every line reads like a locker-room pep talk distilled to its essence.
style_rules: Favor imperative verbs and second-person address ('Find your fast', 'Never stop') to put the athlete at the center of the action.
Sentences are short and rhythmic, often fragments; punctuation is minimal — periods over commas, rarely exclamation points.
Avoid hedging language entirely ('maybe', 'try to'); every claim is stated as inevitable, earned fact.
Product copy pairs a bold emotional hook with one concrete performance detail, never a full spec list.
